completed.summary: Investigated and fixed layout issue causing postflop action buttons to be unreachable. Root cause: PostflopTraining container had no overflow handling; on viewports < 630px, action buttons rendered below the fold. Added overflow-y:auto to root div so content scrolls internally. Verified: both small (position tile) and large (below board) action buttons work correctly — clicking advances street, shows GTO feedback, auto-advances after 1.5s. 53/53 vitest pass. 0 JS console errors. The original bug report ('clicking does not advance') was a viewport/layout issue, not a missing handler — all onClick handlers were properly registered and functional.

Phase 2 bugfixes (Coach-reported HIGH bugs): (1) isPreflopRoundComplete() fold-before-raise fix — added foldedPositions tracking, skipped folded positions in round-completion check. UTG fold → HJ raise → all call now correctly returns true. (2) advanceToNextStreet() timer cleanup — clears autoAdvanceRef at function start to prevent double-advance on manual button click + auto-advance timer race. 53/53 vitest pass, build clean.

Phase 1 of game tree fix: (1) Added isPreflopRoundComplete() detection — round ends when all positions after last raiser have called/folded (equal-action rule). (2) Auto-transition from preflop to postflop mode: generates flop cards, sets up postflop state without requiring manual mode toggle. (3) Added auto-advance timer in PostflopTraining: after user takes action and sees GTO feedback, auto-advances to next street after 1.5s. (4) Added isAllFold() detection (hand-over on all-fold). Remaining: all-in short-circuit to deal remaining streets automatically, and backend-driven round-complete detection.

Added blinds display ('0.5/1') with green circle icon to study page top bar, between stack depth selector and spot count. Matches reference GTO Wizard layout: Cash | 100bb | 0.5/1 | spots. +8 lines in page.tsx. 53/53 vitest pass. 0 JS console errors. Live verified.

Swapped matrix cell color scheme to match reference (app.gtowizard.com/study). raise/all_in/bet → BLUE (#3A6EA5), call/check → GREEN (#00C853), fold → GRAY/dark. Updated legend squares and GTO sizing text for consistency. 53/53 vitest pass. Live verified: AA/AKs cells rgb(58,110,165) blue, K6s fold cells rgb(42,42,42) dark.
